avoid_for: Formal enterprise sales decks, luxury/editorial brand presentations, heavy data-dense financial reports, any context needing premium restraint or dark-mode authority.
best_for: Developer-tool / data-infra landing pages, product launches, technical announcements that want credibility WITHOUT corporate seriousness — a light-canvas, notebook-sketch register that reads playful and confident.
name: MotherDuck
palette_voice: Warm cream canvas (#f4efea) + near-square charcoal-ink (#383838) lines, with a single sky-blue (#6fc2ff) action color and a crayon-bright rainbow (canary/mint/lilac/coral...) reserved strictly for illustration and marquee rhythm — never for filled CTAs.
signature_moves: Hard offset shadow (rgb(56,56,56) -6px 6px 0px 0px) on every button and interactive card — the elevation system
2px near-square corners everywhere — non-negotiable notebook-paper geometry
Hand-drawn line-art mascots (ducks, clouds, speech bubbles) in charcoal + wet-cement strokes, bleeding past container edges
Full-bleed canary-yellow marquee strip between content bands as rhythmic reset
Rainbow-outline button palette distributed across repeated tiles like a pencil cup
tagline: Crayon-coded terminal on cream paper — a developer tool that refuses to dress like one.
typographic_voice: Monospace-first universal face (Aeonik Mono, subst. JetBrains Mono) for every text role — headline whispers at 300 weight, nav commands at 600; 0.0200em positive tracking counteracts monospace density. No serifs, no italics, no decorative display faces.
